steps.title: Opening
steps.goal: Greet the seller by name, introduce yourself from IndiaMART and ask if it is a good time.

steps.title: Purpose: catalog health
steps.goal: Explain that 1 product(s) have no price, which reduces buyer enquiries.

steps.title: Collect missing info
steps.goal: Ask for the price of "1x1 Rib Fabric" (per kg).

steps.title: BuyLead preferences
steps.goal: Ask which BuyLeads in Cotton Knitted Fabric the seller wants (locations / order size).

steps.title: Close
steps.goal: Summarise what was noted, confirm next step and thank the seller.

talkingPoints: Products with a price get more buyer enquiries than those without (general guidance; no specific statistics).
Replies to enquiries can be managed from the Lead Manager in the IndiaMART seller app.
Buyer calls reach the seller through the PNS (Preferred Number Service) number.
Remember: Interested in export garment buyers; new to IndiaMART lead management.
avoid: Inventing statistics, prices or buyer names
Asking for OTPs, passwords or bank details
Pushing paid packages unless the seller asks
